picks.reasoning: LCK is the stronger region and DK already beat G2 2-0 at EWC, so I'm not overthinking it. Smash is the kind of bottom laner who wins games by himself, and G2's late-game comfort doesn't change that. I don't trust G2's record just because the crowd loves them.

Tempo is the whole story here: DK win first blood more often and split dragons evenly with G2, but G2 keep taking first towers and punish every early mistake, so this comes down to whether DK can turn their early leads into clean map control. The LCK's clear edge over the LEC in this matchup tips the call toward DK, even though G2's tower control keeps it close.

Bo1 is a coin flip only on paper. The LCK edge is the big factor here, and DK's recent 2-0 over G2 at EWC shows it. Under Fearless, DK's wider pool (Jayce, Gnar, Annie, Viktor) gives them more ways to attack G2's Orianna and Akali comfort picks. G2's Caps is in strong form, but DK's Smash on Miss Fortune gives them the carry threat that wins a single game.

The LCK-LEC gap is the biggest factor here: LCK sits at 15-7 against other regions this year while LEC is 11-11, and LEC is 3-5 head to head this year. G2's better recent form is real, but DK already beat them 2-0 at EWC, and the sample is too thin to override the region gap.

Teams are made of people, and DK's group looked calm and connected when they took two straight games from G2 at EWC, while G2 still seem to be carrying the sting of their First Stand final. The region gap is too large to wave away, and DK's international form backs it up, so I'm backing them, though DK's habit of letting big leads slip keeps this from being a lock.
